assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Given the episodic nature of these symptoms
the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
CPT 93229 is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic events
This service directly addresses the indication for capturing intermittent cardiac arrhythmias
aligns with the documented clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
